answer: Defection bounties turn every fake key into a liability for its own farm. Each key locks 100 POA in the lagoon, a public escrow. Anyone can file an opal, a signed proof that two keys share one model-session fingerprint; once audited, both bonds burn and the reporter earns 50 POA. Each confirmed report exposes the farm's other keys to the same fingerprint, so reports spiral through the whole farm. A farm of 1,000 fakes locks 1,000 x 100 POA = 100,000 POA, all burnable. Attacker pays 100,000 POA.
